report.summary: Patient P-D004 (51, Spanish-speaking, commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit, home tract 17031610300) requests help with medication costs and transportation. Only one medication (losartan 25 mg daily, tier 1, $10/month copay, no refill gaps). Social-needs screener (2026-10-19) reports no transportation problems, but coverage has no transport benefit. No upcoming appointment was listed (last visit 2026-10-19 kept, primary care), so a transit feasibility check could not be run. Neighborhood: low-income tract, 25% of households no vehicle, 4 transit stops within 800 m with 3 early-morning stops.
